scope: engineering and resource pilot; exploratory internal scores, not final confirmatory results
drug_selection_rule: first two drugs in the frozen coverage-ranked primary panel; no response/performance selection
global_fold_rule: StratifiedGroupKFold on tissue labels and known biological groups; same global identities for both drugs, then intersect drug observations
endpoint: GDSC2 drug-response AUC within frozen drug-specific exact concentration interval; higher is lower sensitivity
tuning_objective: minimum pooled inner out-of-fold RMSE on original GDSC AUC scale; fixed deterministic first-candidate tie break

feature.annotation_rule: predefined exact-annotation protein_coding genes only; no expression-distribution preselection
feature.rank: training log2(TPM+1) MAD descending; stable Ensembl ID ascending for ties
feature.reo_encoding: raw TPM order: +1/-1; exact ties including double zero=0; no tolerance or rounding
feature.missing_rule: current finite complete TPM input only; fail/record if missing, do not silently replace missing with tie
feature.empty_feature_fallback: training mean prediction, status and failure retained

elastic_net.standardization: feature StandardScaler and target mean/population SD fitted on the current training rows
elastic_net.tissue_handling: unpenalized tissue effects through training-only FWL residualization after expression/REO construction; full one-hot, no dropped reference; unseen tissue effect=0 on globally centered target

external_response_access: forbidden; no CTRP raw response read for tuning, timing, fitting or evaluation
statistical_inference: none in pilot; report OOF point metrics and failures, no confirmatory p-values or confidence intervals
planned_full_analysis: 5 outer folds x 3 repeats, 3 inner folds; REO200 and strong expression2000; RF and inference remain pending
